course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A fast-food restaurant has one drive-in window. Cars arrive according to a Poisson distribution at the (15) rate of 2 cars every 5 minutes. The space in front of the window can accommodate at most 10 cars, including the one being served. Others car can wait outside this space if necessary. The service time per customers is exponential, with a mean of 1.5 minutes. Determine the following:
i) The probability that a customer must wait to get the service.
ii) The expected waiting until a customer reaches the window to place an order.
iii) The probability that the waiting line will exceed the 10-sapce capacity.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
